create_gradcam_instance: create a GradCAM instance with a model, target layers, data mean, and data std for video heatmap visualization
calculate_localization_map: calculate Grad-CAM localization maps for input video clips and return model predictions
visualize_heatmap_on_video: visualize Grad-CAM localization maps overlaid on input video clips as heatmaps with configurable transparency
register_layer_hooks: register forward and backward hooks on convolutional layers to capture gradients and activations
normalize_localization_map: normalize Grad-CAM localization maps to [0, 1] range using min-max scaling and trilinear interpolation
